# Sarcastic Meme Photos Directory

Drop your sarcastic / meme photos here! The cheat code system will automatically load them when Meme Mode is activated.

### Supported File Names:
- `sathwik.jpeg`
- `sathesh.png` (or `.jpeg`)
- `vamsi.jpeg`
- `ashwini.jpeg`
- `viswanath.jpeg`
- `steelbinde.jpeg`
- `aakash.jpeg`
- `harshith.jpeg`
- `harshitha.jpeg`
- `munisankar.jpeg`
- `hemasri.jpeg`

> **Note:** If any sarcastic photo is not yet provided, the app will automatically and safely fall back to the real photo.
